scope: Completed historical experiments only; no new theory, method, experiment, inference, training, or GPU work.
chronology_policy: Sort by the best-supported real execution start date. Preserve day precision when an exact launch timestamp did not survive. When two runs share a day, use a documented dependency as the tie-break.
information_policy: A visible packet is a minimal, protocol-sufficient subset of facts available before its episode began, not an exhaustive history. This avoids later packets leaking earlier benchmark answers.

temporal_evidence_grades.A: A pre-result preregistration or explicitly frozen protocol survives.
temporal_evidence_grades.B: A raw/hash-backed artifact preserves protocol identity, but no standalone pre-result document survives.
temporal_evidence_grades.C: Protocol-only retrospective reconstruction; all measurements, outcome language, and post-hoc interpretation were excluded.
